title: Moon's theorem on vertex-pancyclicity of diconnected tournaments
statement: Let $D$ be a diconnected tournament on a finite vertex set with at least three vertices, and let $u$ be any vertex of $D$. Then for every integer $k$ with $3 \le k \le \abs{V(D)}$ there is a directed cycle of length $k$ passing through $u$.
hypotheses_covered: D is a tournament (orientation of the complete graph)
D is diconnected (every vertex reaches every other)
u is a vertex of D
